title: Reuwu
tagline: Platform to post reviews about movies and earn tip for quality reviews.
description: With the usage of blockchain, Reuwu provides a decentralized movie review platform where critics and movie buffs can publish reviews and receive tips for excellent work. A user can enter a review by specifying the movie name, genre, personal rating and a brief description about the movie.
how_its_made: The project uses React, Bootstrap, and Material-UI for frontend and Solidity. Any user who find a review can tip the author in in crypto, ensuring credible payments and avoiding the need for intermediaries, also reducing transaction charges in the process. Since posting reviews on the platform involves some gas fees, unecessary reviews can be avoided and quality can be upheld on the dApp.
